item.title: Delhi HC restrains “SettlementGuru” from using Bajaj Finance trademark and inducing loan defaults through social media
item.description: “Since the trademarks of the plaintiff are registered, the balance of convenience is tilted in favour of the plaintiff and in case, ex-parte ad-interim injunction is not granted, the reputation and goodwill of the petitioner may be injured.” The post Delhi HC restrains “SettlementGuru” from using Bajaj Finance trademark and inducing loan defaults through social media appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cheques Bounced? Supreme Court Confirms You Can File Multiple Complaints under S. 138 NI Act for the Same Transaction
item.description: “A separate cause of action arises upon each dishonour of a cheque provided the statutory sequence of presentation, dishonour, notice, and failure to pay is complete.” The post Cheques Bounced? Supreme Court Confirms You Can File Multiple Complaints under S. 138 NI Act for the Same Transaction appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Orissa High Court: Denial of Head Constable post to dependent spouse of disabled combatant unjustified; humane approach mandated in compassionate appointments
item.description: “A society, which does not hold the Defence Personnel in high esteem, will do disservice to itself, inasmuch as its own security will be at stake, if those who guard it are not regarded.” The post Orissa High Court: Denial of Head Constable post to dependent spouse of disabled combatant unjustified; humane approach mandated in compassionate appointments appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay HC constitutes common Arbitral Tribunal for deciding for disputes arising from all inter-connected Essar-Narayan contracts
item.description: “A common reference to the Arbitral Tribunal for resolution of disputes and differences arising out of all such agreements and contracts was requested by the respondent which was agreed upon by the applicant.” The post Bombay HC constitutes common Arbitral Tribunal for deciding for disputes arising from all inter-connected Essar-Narayan contracts appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises on Amagi Media Labs IPO
item.description: The IPO was led by major book running lead managers and marked a significant milestone for India’s adtech and media technology sector. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises on Amagi Media Labs IPO appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Call for Participation | 5TH IILM MOOT COURT COMPETITION, 2026
item.description: IILM University, Gurugram invites law students to participate in the 5th IILM Moot Court Competition 2026, an offline national moot with a prize pool of up to ₹6 lakh. The post Call for Participation | 5TH IILM MOOT COURT COMPETITION, 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Rajasthan HC recalls Rs. 1 Lakh fine of man languishing in jail despite release order; Calls out advocates on strikes over working Saturdays
item.description: “When lawyers boycott the Courts, it directly violates the rights of the litigants to speedy justice, as guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution.” The post Rajasthan HC recalls Rs. 1 Lakh fine of man languishing in jail despite release order; Calls out advocates on strikes over working Saturdays appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madras High Court: Denial of maternity leave for third pregnancy unsustainable; State directed to extend benefits
item.description: “The respondents have not understood the principle underlying in those orders and that repeatedly rejecting the plea of employees seeking maternity benefits for third pregnancy is an agonizing fact.” The post Madras High Court: Denial of maternity leave for third pregnancy unsustainable; State directed to extend benefits appeared first on SCC Times.
